svg.title: AGV R20 electrical schematic
svg.desc: ESP32 UWB Pro v1.2 connects to IN1–IN4 of an L298N dual H-bridge module and a 3.3 V compatible piezo buzzer. An INA228 monitors the protected logic battery through its shunt. Motor and logic batteries have separate positive supplies and a common system return.
svg.text: ESP32 UWB Pro direct control | 5 V control supply, 3.3 V signals, separate motor supply
A CONTROL SUPPLY AND BATTERY SENSING
Set U2 to 5.00 V. Use the U2 USB charge input with S1 open.
No flyback diodes fitted. Motor operation is unverified.
Remove 5V-EN regulator jumper before feeding +5V_SW into the 5V terminal.
* ENA/ENB are not used by the ESP32. Internal enable wiring is unverified.
Drawing references: IEC 61082-1 for document layout · IEC 60617 for graphical symbols
Identical net names are connected. Solid dots mark joins. 0V_SYS is the shared DC return. Keep BAT_RET separate outside U2.
* Confirm the INA228 module pinout and shunt value. Connect V+ to I+ and V− to 0V_SYS only on the matching variant.
S1/S2 are shown open. 1 and 2 are drawing identifiers. Verify switch pinout, motor stall current and ESP32 firmware on the bench.
Hardware record only. ST requires flyback protection for inductive loads. Do not energize the motors as shown.
